title: Dominated convergence of real Lebesgue integrals
statement: Use $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field]. Let $m\geq1$ be an integer, and equip $\mathbf R^m$ with Lebesgue measure. Let $F_n:\mathbf R^m\to\mathbf R$ for $n\in\mathbf N$ and $f:\mathbf R^m\to\mathbf R$ be Lebesgue-measurable functions. Suppose that $g:\mathbf R^m\to\mathbf R$ is Lebesgue integrable, that $|F_n(x)|\leq g(x)$ for almost every $x$ for each $n$, and that $F_n(x)\to f(x)$ for almost every $x$. Then $$\int_{\mathbf R^m}F_n(x)\,dx\longrightarrow\int_{\mathbf R^m}f(x)\,dx.$$
